subject: organic
question:
有机化学·保护基化学：下列哪组反应条件能够脱除所示保护基：TBDPS ether（tert-butyldiphenylsilyl ether）？
A. TBAF, THF
B. N₂H₄·H₂O, EtOH, heat
C. HgCl₂, CaCO₃, MeCN/H₂O
D. DIBAL-H, CH₂Cl₂, −78 °C
explanation: A bulky silyl ether far more stable to acid than TBS; fluoride removes it.
